definitions.explanation: Indicates that something is used, consumed, or spent in its entirety without anything remaining or being left out.
Describes something or someone that is round and plump in a way that often suggests good health or abundance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{丸々|まるまる}⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I used up an entire day off.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボーナス→ボーナス：05878_boonasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{丸々|まるまる}⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: My entire bonus is still left untouched.

examples.japanese: ⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{丸々|まるまる}⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧か{月|げつ}⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: The preparations took a full three months.

examples.japanese: {丸々|まるまる}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{太|ふと}った→太る：01190_futoru⟧⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There is a plump, round cat.
When autumn comes, squirrels get plump and round.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{丸々|まるまる}とした⟦{頬|ほお}→頬：03717_hoo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かわいい→かわいい：00857_kawaii⟧。
examples.english: The baby's plump cheeks are cute.

notes:
USAGE: The two senses of {丸々|まるまる} are distinct in usage.

Sense 1 (completely): Modifies time periods or quantities, emphasizing that the entire amount was used or remains.
- {丸々|まるまる}⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧ (a whole day)
- {丸々|まるまる}⟦{一冊|いっさつ}→一冊：23149_issatsu⟧ (an entire book)
- {丸々|まるまる}⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧ (to remain entirely)

Sense 2 (plump): Almost always appears as {丸々|まるまる}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{太|ふと}る→太る：01190_futoru⟧ or {丸々|まるまる}とした, describing healthy roundness. It is generally a positive or neutral description, unlike ⟦{太|ふと}っている→太る：01190_futoru⟧ alone which can sound blunt.
